novelty.justification: The claim hypothesizes that a fact carries a "separable signal about how well and from what kind of source it learned that fact" that is "distinct from both the fact content and the model's output logit confidence" and causally controls hedging or deferral, so its novelty route is a multi-dimensional provenance mechanism rather than merely a new factual-recall setting. Searches using "LLM activations training provenance fact frequency contradiction reliability probe," "internal confidence direction factual knowledge," and "training order linearly encoded activations" identify Fresh in Memory: Training-order Recency Is Linearly Encoded in Language Model Activations (2025) as the closest work because it already reports decodable acquisition metadata independent of confidence; No Answer Needed (2025) similarly decodes prospective answer correctness, while Characterizing Mechanisms for Factual Recall in Language Models (Geva et al., 2023) links fact frequency to conflict resolution and causally controls that resolution. Extending these results from acquisition time or correctness to frequency, source diversity, and contradiction metadata—and positing one content- and logit-separable signal that causally governs epistemic behavior—is a substantive multi-step integration, but it is a natural extension of those established directions rather than a wholly new core paradigm.
